title: Crash when current_function null in GDScriptParser::parse_statement()
body:
### Tested versions

repro in Godot 4.7 dev 4 and custom branch e9eecc411f2b6cddb0f1001db1da3ed73b68c307

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable (14d1969) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Mon, 09 Feb 2026 17:16:33 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 21.1.6, DRM 3.64, 6.18.9-arch1-2) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 28.18 GiB memory

### Issue description

Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot-vscode-plugin/issues/1007

I was typing code this code in vscode while the game was running (I did ctrl + z to get back to where I was, and for the video I played it back with ctrl + y)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ad58b283-c184-4648-87d7-905d253c3872

code block before:
```gdscript
var path_to_hash = {}
func save_hash_for(path):
	path_to_hash[path] = FileAccess.get_modified_time(path)

func does_file_hash_differ_for(path):
	if path not in path_to_hash:
		save_hash_for(path)
		return false
	if path_to_hash[path] != FileAccess.get_modified_time(path):
		save_hash_for(path)
		await get_tree().create_timer(.3).timeout
		return true
	return false
```
Code block after (as shown in the video, maybe the extra `()` inserted could be related?)
```gdscript
var path_to_hash = {}
func save_hash_for(path):
	path_to_hash[path] = Globals.read_file(path)

func does_file_hash_differ_for(path):
	if path not in path_to_hash:
		save_hash_for(path)
		return false
	if path_to_hash[path] != FileAccess.get_modified_time(path):
		save_hash_for(path)
		await get_tree().create_timer(.3).timeout
		return true
	return false
```
